summary:
Enthusiastic and dedicated Associate Professor of English with 15 years of experience including at the
Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Dhanbad. Passionate about literature and committed to academic
excellence and research. I am committed to creating a stimulating academic environment that
encourages intellectual curiosity and supports the integration of literary insights with technical
disciplines.
